units.source_text: 继祖父的葬礼之后，姑奶奶的葬礼、伯父的葬礼、恩师的葬礼，以及其他亲人的葬礼，都使我悲伤不已。

en.t: After my grandfather's funeral came the funerals of my great-aunt, my uncle, my beloved teacher, and other relatives, and they all filled me with unbearable sadness.

units.source_text: 在表兄举行婚礼的可庆可贺的日子里，亡父遗留下来的礼服装饰过我的身躯，

en.t: On the happy and auspicious day when my cousin held his wedding, the formal clothes left by my late father adorned my body,

units.source_text: 而在举行数不清的葬礼的日子里，却把我送到了墓地。

en.t: but on the days of countless funerals, they carried me instead to the cemetery.

units.source_text: 我终于成了参加葬礼的名人。

en.t: In the end, I became famous for attending funerals.
